posts.zh:
pet-whale 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠：纯 SVG 动画随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错），可戳可拖、双击翻滚，光标停留在身侧会自己避让，7 套色板并跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4ce8ff3a2d21af62041a.html
posts.en:
pet-whale is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline: pure-SVG animation follows agent state (thinking, working, celebrating, error), with poke and double-click flip interactions, cursor avoidance, 7 palettes, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4ce8ff3a2d21af62041a.html
